# Notis

> Select text on any page, or pin an image, and leave a comment. One script, one small serverless function, no accounts. MIT licensed.

- [Add Notis to a site (instructions for an agent)](https://notis.gavinwye.com/install.md)
- [README and API](https://github.com/gavinwye/notis.gavinwye.com#readme)
- [The script](https://notis.gavinwye.com/comments.js)
